detail_text: This effort is only open to current IO/T MATOC holders who hold contracts with CEHNC (W912DY) and not open to the public. SUBJECT: Pre-Bid Site Visit, LOCATION: Immunization Center and Optical Fabrication Laboratory, Ft. Jackson, SC. A pre-bid site visit is scheduled for 10 March 2026 at 0830. This is for informational purposes only; no bid submissions are required at this time. For further details, please refer to the Draft Performance Work Statement. Attendance is limited to a maximum of two representatives per contractor. Please confirm receipt of this memorandum and the 14 attachments.
